QF.id: XVI Clearing, Settlement and Risk Management_48

question.text: If the exchange imposes a special margin of 1% on a gold contract worth Rs 45,00,000, the additional amount required is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Special margin = 1% x Rs 45,00,000 = Rs 45,000. The source workbook gives this exact gold-contract example. Special margin is collected over and above the initial margin, ELM, and other margins already on the position. The Trap: Rs 4,500 is 0.1%, Rs 4,50,000 is 10%, and Rs 450 is 0.01%. Special margin is also distinct from additional margin: special margin is imposed on one side (buy or sell), while additional margin is imposed on both sides.
